1. Use the `PimaIndiansDiabetes` dataset. Use 15% data for testing. Use cross-validation with of 7 folds to tune random forest `(method='ranger')`.  What are the parameters that produce the greatest accuracy? What is the testing accuracy. 

```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(tidyverse)
data(SynthDiabetes)
df <- as_tibble(SynthDiabetes)
df %>% names
```


```{r}
library(caret)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    diabetes = as.factor(diabetes)
  )

df = drop_na(df)

split_index = createDataPartition(df$diabetes, p = .85, list = FALSE)
df_train = df[split_index, ]
df_test = df[-split_index, ]
```


```{r}
trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number=7)
forest = train(diabetes ~., data=df_train, method="ranger", trControl=trControl)

forest$bestTune

predict = predict(forest, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overall[1]

plot(forest)
```


2. Use the `PimaIndiansDiabetes` dataset. Go to https://topepo.github.io/caret/available-models.html and pick a classification model.  Tune the classification model using cross-validation of 7 folds. 


```{r}
# iter the iterations
# maxdepth, the tree depth
# nu, the learning rate
trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number=7)

adaboost = train(diabetes ~., data=df_train, method="ada", trControl=trControl)

adaboost$bestTune

predict = predict(adaboost, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overall[1]

plot(adaboost)
```


3. (Model Comparison) Use the `PimaIndiansDiabetes` dataset. Pick two models at [this link](https://topepo.github.io/caret/available-models.html) to compare using 7-fold cross validation method. Evaluate the accuracy of the final model on the test data. 

```{r}
trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number=7)
pda = train(diabetes ~., data=df_train, method="pda", trControl=trControl)

pda$bestTune

predict = predict(pda, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overall[1]

plot(pda)
```

```{r}
trControl = trainControl(method = "cv", number=7)
knn = train(diabetes ~., data=df_train, method="knn", trControl=trControl)

knn$bestTune

predict = predict(knn, df_test)
confusion = confusionMatrix(data=predict, reference=df_test$diabetes, positive="pos")
confusion$overall[1]

plot(knn)
```
